commit_scope: Compost the operational sections of AGENTS.md that described tissue the body no longer carries: the fixed cheap-executor contract, environment-variable knobs the application never reads, a Form file that moved, the spring interface list, eleven pointer docs no index circulates, and the overnight-pipeline command wall.
evidence_refs: Verified 2026-10-20 against the tree and the live OpenAPI: every script, route and doc AGENTS.md named exists except form/form/form-stdlib/form-cli-main.fk (moved into the form-cli organs under form/form/form-stdlib/bml/) and specs/006-overnight-backlog.md (gone); both references are healed or removed.

The 2-Tier Executor / Task Card / Budget / Prompt Contract / Validation Loop / Proof Record sections fixed `openai/gpt-4o-mini` and token budgets in prose; api/app/config_loader.py carries the executor truth (`agent_executor.default` = federation, `disable_codex_executor` true, `auto_execute` false; `agent_cost.*`) and the last 80 rows of docs/system_audit/model_executor_runs.jsonl name openai/gpt-5. Folded into one 'Executor proof record' section that points at the config keys and the ledger.

The Codex pipeline and Telegram sections named AGENT_AUTO_EXECUTE, PAID_TOOL_*, AGENT_TASK_MAX_COST_USD, OPENCLAW_MODEL and TELEGRAM_* environment variables; grep of api/app finds no reads of them — they are the `agent_executor`, `agent_cost` and `telegram` blocks of api/config/api.json overlaid by ~/.coherence-network/config.json, which the sections now name (the hard rule on the same page forbids the env form).

Key Files pointed at docs/STATUS.md, PLAN, SPEC-COVERAGE, SPEC-TRACKING, MODEL-ROUTING, AGENT-DEBUGGING, PIPELINE-ATTENTION, PIPELINE-MONITORING-AUTOMATED, META-QUESTIONS, RUNBOOK, REFERENCE-REPOS (last touched Feb–Aug 2026; neither MANIFEST.md nor docs/INDEX.md circulates any of them). They stay in the tree as history and are named as such in one line; the list now carries the arrival surfaces (CLAUDE.md, the start packet, MANIFEST/INDEX, DEPLOY with its native reminder, PRODUCTION-SUBSTRATE, PR triage, spec quality gate, glossary).

The overnight-pipeline command wall (api/scripts/run_autonomous.sh, run_overnight_pipeline.sh, the watchdog — untouched since Feb–Apr 2026, referenced only by scripts/clear_queue_and_start_flow.sh) is one pointer with its config truth; the web's API base is named as public config (web/lib/public-config.ts) with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL as the carrier's build-time override.

Structural check after the rewrite: every path AGENTS.md names resolves (the remaining grep hits are api/scripts paths written as `cd api && ./scripts/…` and runtime outputs). 364 lines from 443; 34 insertions, 127 deletions.

Noticed, left for its owner: api/app/services/automation_usage_service.py reads OPENAI_RESPONSES_URL / ANTHROPIC_MESSAGES_URL and quota-probe model names through os.getenv — the one application-code reader of environment the audit found.
